Each N≤U1 and N≤U2 replaces min service distance with an endpoint distance; their coefficient vectors are independently reconstructed. The identities 9ZT1−4U1 and 9ZT2−4U2 have strictly nonnegative monomial coefficients on the nonnegative gap cone; reflection covers T3,T4. value.rationale: The result fixes the exact approximation loss of a named strategyproof randomized two-facility rule at the first five-agent population where known deterministic strategyproof mechanisms cannot beat factor 3. Its sharp factor 9/4 both strengthens the mechanism-wide bound 4 and makes the random-versus-deterministic efficiency gap explicit. It is a natural missing finite-population guarantee with an exact extremal family and an all-real continuous proof, not a small computational table or arbitrary parameter cut.
